title: Vox Machina - Campaign One
description: A group of unlikely heroes embarks on a chaotic journey across a magical land, battling dragons, uncovering dark secrets, and forging unbreakable bonds as they fight to protect their world from ruin.

episodes.title: Arrival at Kraghammer
episodes.description: Following their victory in Imman, the party travels to the Dwarven citadel of Kraghammer to investigate a dark vision concerning Lady Kima of Or. After navigating the treacherous underground metropolis and securing entry, the ragtag group finds lodging in the boisterous tavern. As they attempt to celebrate their arrival by buying drinks for the entire establishment, the room falls silent and all eyes turn to the newcomers, leaving the party to face the stares of the dwarven patrons and the barkeep's confused expression.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Into the Greyspine
episodes.description: In this episode of Critical Role, the party gathers to share their rich backstories, revealing the tragic histories and unique talents of warriors like Grog and mages like Tiberius. Before diving into the new adventure, they recap their recent arrival in the dwarven town of Krakhamer, where they aided workers fleeing a terrifying naga-based hydra abomination while searching for a missing paladin. With adrenaline still pumping from the battle, the group must now determine their next move as they delve deeper into the dark evil manifesting beneath the mines.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Strange Bedfellows
episodes.description: The party ventures into the dark Mitchell mines to rescue Lady Kima, only to be ambushed by monstrous creatures that leave their Goliath friend catatonic and brain-dead. Desperate for answers, they interrogate a captured Duragar who reveals that Lady Kima has already been killed and eaten by the underground horrors. With a poisoned blade at the creature's throat, the heroes must choose between mercy and vengeance just as they prepare to confront the terrifying master Cavane.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Attack on the Duergar Warcamp
episodes.description: The party ventures deep into the mines beneath Craig Hammer to locate the missing Lady Kima of Ward, battling mutated creatures and uncovering a derrogar war camp along the way. After forming a tense alliance with a cast-out mind flayer named Clarota, the group finally reunites with their friend Pike, who reveals she was driven away by a vision and protected by Lady Kima's own sigil. Now that Pike is safe, the party must navigate the uneasy presence of the psychic entity while determining if their new ally is truly trustworthy or hiding a darker agenda.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: The Trick About Falling
episodes.description: The party infiltrates a Duragar war camp beneath Kraghammer, defeating a massive burrowing beast and interrogating the defeated general about the whereabouts of the missing paladin, Lady Kima. Under pressure from the Mineflayer Clarota's psychic abilities, the general reveals that Kima was delivered to King Marigold in the dungeons of Emberhold and hints at a secret tunnel leading to the stronghold. As the general bleeds out and whispers terrifying details about a shadowy entity named Cavare, the party must decide whether to execute their captive or press him for more secrets before the truth of the underground threat is fully revealed.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Breaching the Emberhold
episodes.description: After surviving a chaotic escape from the Duragar war camp and a brutal battle against a mutated black ooze, the party finds themselves stranded in a scorching lava tunnel beneath the Dwarven City of Craig Hammer. With their druid damaged and the heat becoming unbearable, the group must navigate the dangerous magma pools while searching for the missing Lady Kima before their supplies run dry. As they push deeper into the sweltering darkness, the rising heat and dwindling water supplies threaten to turn their desperate journey into a fatal one before they can find a way out.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: The Throne Room
episodes.description: After rescuing Lady Kima from the Drowar fortress of Emberhold, the party navigates the treacherous underdark corridors while managing a tenuous alliance with their mind flayer companion, Chlorota. Seeking Kima's lost equipment in the armory, the group moves stealthily through dark hallways, only to discover a lone smithy guard working alone in the center of the stronghold. As the party vanishes into invisibility to bypass the guard, Vax strikes the unsuspecting warrior with a sneak attack, leaving the outcome of the sudden ambush hanging in the balance.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Glass and Bone
episodes.description: After slaying the Duragar King and rescuing Lady Kima, the party faces a desperate escape from the collapsing Emberhold fortress as molten rock floods the caverns. While dragging their petrified companions to safety, they discover their friend Grog has been kidnapped by the Queen, leaving the group to debate whether to risk a rescue attempt or flee while the fortress crumbles. With the Duragar forces closing in and the lava rising, the party must decide their next move before it is too late.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Yug'voril Uncovered
episodes.description: The party plunges deep into the Underdark beneath Kraghammer to rescue the missing folk hero Lady Kima from the evil Derragar fortress of Emberhold. After battling mutated beasts and freeing Kima, they discover their friend Grog has been captured and dominated by the sinister Queen Ularra. Now infiltrating the queen's camp, the heroes face a tense standoff where they claim to be an elite task force, but the confrontation with the queen and her guards is about to erupt into full combat.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: K'Varn Revealed
episodes.description: After uncovering a sinister alliance between illithids and duragar beneath Kraghammer, the party reaches a secluded beachside cavern where they discover a destroyed camp. Suddenly, the rotting corpses rise as intelligent undead, forcing the group into a desperate battle where magical blasts incinerate several foes but leave one party member paralyzed by poison magic. Now stranded on a pile of rubble, the incapacitated hero must survive the onslaught as the remaining horrors close in.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: The Temple Showdown
episodes.description: While exploring the ruins of a subterranean city, the party stumbles upon a foul-smelling encampment guarded by a massive, malformed giant. Using a domination spell, they attempt to control the creature, but their plan to bind it with rope fails when the beast shatters its bonds and attacks the group. Now in full retreat, the adventurers must race to retrieve sleep arrows before the enraged giant catches up and crushes them in the dark.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Escape from the Underdark
episodes.description: After defeating the corrupted beholder Kavarn and breaching the ancient Illithid city of Yugboril, the party finds Lady Kima frozen in stone and confronts the reawakening Elder Brain. While attempting to decipher the Horn of Orcus's true purpose, the group is suddenly overwhelmed by a swarm of loyal mind flayers who reconnect with their hive mind. With the temple collapsing around them and the party facing certain death, they must choose between fleeing the collapsing ruins or standing their ground as the Elder Brain fully awakens.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Shopping and Shipping
episodes.description: After a harrowing journey through the Underdark, the party returns to their keep in Ymon having slain the mad Bahamut holder Kavarn and rescued the stone-bound paladin Lady Kima. Despite securing the evil Horn of Orcus in a bag of holding, a mysterious summons from the Council of Taldore demands their immediate attention regarding the artifact's safety and their return conditions. As they step into the palace to meet the Emperor, the party must decide how to handle the Council's demands regarding the Horn of Orcus.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Skyward
episodes.description: Following their victory in the Underdark, the party returns to Iman to divide the spoils from their shopping spree at Gilmore's Glorious Goods. They debate over powerful new gear like the Belt of Dwarven Kind and an Iron Stone for spell storage, while Scanlon attempts to engineer a tasing glove despite realizing advanced tech like night vision is impossible to build. With only two days remaining before the Holy Receptacle arrives, the group must decide if they can complete their ambitious tinkering projects in time or if they must leave their inventions unfinished.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Enter Vasselheim
episodes.description: After securing the indestructible Horn of Orchist, Vox Machina embarks on a perilous sky ship journey across the Osmitsi to seal the artifact away in the Platinum Sanctuary. Along the way, the crew faces bandit attacks, navigates magical mishaps like Scanlan's sudden beard growth, and trades valuable items to survive the worsening weather. As the sky darkens and snow begins to fall, the party's destination looms closer, but a mysterious cold front hints at dangers yet to come.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Hubris
episodes.description: After sealing the Horn of Orcus and visiting Pike's new temple, the party travels to a new district in Vasselheim dominated by the war god Cord. There, they discover a massive fortress-like structure known as the Trial Forge, where locals explain that the area is dedicated to proving oneself through battle. As the thunder begins to rumble and the iron doors loom before them, the party stands ready to step into the unknown, but the darkness hides secrets they are not yet prepared to face.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Trial of the Take
episodes.description: After narrowly surviving a Hydra attack in the harsh city of Vassalheim, the party prepares for their next mysterious assignment at the Slayer's Guildhall. While crafting makeshift explosives and storing extra spells, they are joined by a striking new companion with demonic blood and a mysterious aura. As they finalize their preparations and welcome their new tank, the guild hall holds a secret that could change their mission before they even step out the door.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Trial of the Take: Part 2
episodes.description: After tracking a dragon north through the Vestpertemberlands, the party discovers a cavern guarded by two frost giants who immediately attack with boulders and axes. While Vex lands a devastating disintegrate spell on one foe, the other giant overpowers the group by slamming a massive rock into Vex, leaving her battered and prone. With one giant down but the other still standing and furious, the party braces for the enraged giant's next devastating blow as the battle hangs in the balance.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Trial of the Take: Part 3
episodes.description: Following a melancholic breakfast at the Bellows' Respite, the party restocks their supplies and retrieves the Flying Carpet before venturing into the city to consult a mysterious fortune teller. Trista reveals her true hag form and sells them empty flasks, but ominously warns that something terrible is about to happen before abruptly refusing to share more details. The party is left with the hag's cryptic prophecy hanging in the air, wondering what fate awaits them next.

episodes.title: Trial of the Take: Part 4
episodes.description: After joining the Slayers' Guild in Vassalheim, Vox Machina pursues a Rakshasa into a treacherous subterranean tunnel where they accidentally slip into a rotting refuse pit. There, they are ambushed by a terrifying Ahtiug and swarms of rats, forcing the party to unleash devastating fire magic to hold their ground against the grotesque beast. As the creature is forced back into the refuse, the party realizes the true danger lies beneath their feet, leaving them to fight for their lives against the monstrous horde.

episodes.title: AraMente to Pyrah
episodes.description: After choosing to join the Slayers' Take guild rather than face judgment for breaking the Law of Asselaim, the party successfully completes their trial and reunites in the guildhall. Huntmaster Vanessa then leads the newly accepted members down a dark, ancient corridor to a mysterious chamber where they must undergo a branding ritual. As they ascend a towering ziggurat structure, the party notices unsettling carvings of an eye within a sickle, leaving them to wonder if the branding ritual will reveal the guild's true, possibly sinister, secrets.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: The Rematch
episodes.description: After securing blessings from the Pyra tribe and returning to Vassalheim, Vox Machina finds themselves resting in the Guild Hall while dealing with Scanlan's chaotic stories and Tiberius's mysterious illness. With plans to collect gold in Kraghammer, the party steps out into the city streets only to witness a massive Goliath heading northward. As they give chase to the fleeing giant and a trail of distressed citizens, the Goliath suddenly vanishes into the ground, leaving the heroes to mark one of the fleeing figures as they realize the danger is closer than they thought.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: The Feast
episodes.description: After settling affairs in Vassalheim and dealing with a fan outside Grayskull Keep, the party prepares for a tense political feast with the notorious Briarwood family. Percy reveals his traumatic past, confessing that the Briarwoods slaughtered his entire family years ago and that he now carries a loaded revolver marked with their names. As the guests arrive, Percy stands ready to execute his vengeance, leaving the party to decide whether to intervene before the deadly confrontation begins.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Crimson Diplomacy
episodes.description: Vox Machina members attend a formal feast in Iman where Percy disguises himself as Vax to navigate the political gathering, but the tension spikes when a rogue infiltrates the Briarwoods' private quarters. Confronted by the couple, the intruder is trapped by magical charm effects and subdued guards, forcing a desperate struggle against the Briarwoods' predatory hospitality. As arcane energy coils around the character and the spell's effects intensify, the intruder must resist the Briarwoods' enchantment before the spell consumes them.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Consequences and Cows
episodes.description: After a chaotic political banquet where the Briarwoods escaped and a hunted tiefling named Lilith fled to safety, Vox Machina returns to Gray Skull Keep to regroup. However, tensions rise as Lilith departs for the Osman Sea, leaving Percy isolated and visibly distressed in his workshop, muttering darkly about forfeited souls. The party grows increasingly concerned as Percy's erratic behavior and cryptic warnings suggest a deeper, darker secret is brewing beneath his madness.

episodes.title: The Path to Whitestone
episodes.description: After facing political repercussions for their actions at the Briar Woods, the party turned their attention to helping northern farmers by chasing a gargantuan bird to the mountains and convincing a druid to relocate it. Yet, the darkness of Percy's past has returned to haunt the keep, where he awakens from a nightmare to find an invisible entity slaughtering guards and terrorizing the workshop. As Trinket engages the unseen foe, Percy leaps into the fray to defend his friends, but the creature's true nature remains hidden in the shadows.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: The Sun Tree
episodes.description: The party's journey through the Alabaster of Sierra's mountain range is cut short when a massive, electrically charged blue beast ambushes them in the narrow pass. Despite Percy's sharpshooting and Grog's furious rage, the creature unleashes a devastating lightning bolt that critically injures their healer, Trinket, leaving him unconscious and fading. With the monster still standing and Trinket's life hanging in the balance, the party faces a desperate choice to save their friend before it's too late.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Whispers
episodes.description: Under the cover of a powerful illusion, Vox Machina has infiltrated the Briarwoods-occupied city of Whitestone to establish a secret base while Keyleth attempts a desperate eight-hour ritual to revive the dead Suntry tree. While the druid works the roots, the rest of the party gathers water and scouts the chilly outskirts, navigating past undead giants and avoiding the city's watchful eyes. As they push through the partially open gate into the graveyard, the party must decide whether to investigate the dark woods beyond or retreat before the undead giants and the Briarwoods discover their secret.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Stoke the Flames
episodes.description: Vox Machina infiltrates the Briarwoods' controlled city of Whitestone to avenge Percival's murdered family, successfully eliminating the corrupt Sir Carian and his allies. However, the victory comes at a disturbing cost as Percival reveals a dark dream-driven ritual that requires sacrificing souls to fuel his quest for vengeance. Now back in their tavern amidst the rain, the party realizes Percival is losing his grip on reality and fears he may have already crossed a point of no return, leaving them to wonder if they can stop him before he consumes them all.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Gunpowder Plot: Part 1
episodes.description: Returning to the dark, zombie-infested city of Whitestone, the party launches a two-pronged assault against the corrupt Briar Woods nobles to free the town. Splitting up, Scanlan polymorphs into a triceratops to smash through Duke Vedmeyer’s estate while the rest of the team infiltrates the back entrance. Now trapped inside the foyer under a hail of crossbow bolts, the triceratops hero must survive the ambush before the charging guards breach the dining room where the fight is just beginning.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Gunpowder Plot: Part 2
episodes.description: The party casts a dramatic sky spell to display the Dorolo crest before looting a mysterious estate, where they discover a secret hatch leading to a basement filled with a coffin and ledgers detailing a halted trade on enchanted White Stone. After smashing the coffin and uncovering the stone's unique enchanting properties, the group is forced to flee as a zombie giant rampages through the house and they set the entire building ablaze. Now escaping into the pouring rain with stolen treasures, the party must wonder if the halted trade is the only secret the city of Whitestone is hiding, leaving them to face whatever else the stone trade has concealed.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Against the Tide of Bone
episodes.description: The Vox Machina party infiltrates the oppressed city of Whitestone to confront the tyrannical Briarwoods, only to discover that Percy's long-lost sister Cassandra is still alive within the castle. After triggering a chaotic uprising and destroying the vampire guardian, the group is forced to flee westward as a massive horde of skeletal undead swarms the streets, aided by newly armed villagers. Just as they reach a defensive wall, the radiant apparition of Keyleth appears to help them escape, but the endless tide of skeletons continues to breach their defenses, leaving the party trapped on the precipice of a desperate battle.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Reunions: Part 1
episodes.description: Vox Machino descends into the dungeons of Castle Whitestone to rescue Percy and dismantle the Briarwoods' oppressive regime, only to find a mysterious prisoner hiding in the shadows. After dispelling her magical disguise, the party discovers the old woman is actually Anna, a former chief scientific designer who helped the Briarwoods reestablish control over the city. Now facing a dangerous choice, the party must decide whether to trust her secrets before she begins explaining the horrifying experiments conducted beneath the castle.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Reunions: Part 2
episodes.description: The party successfully dismantles a burning arcane construct, with Scanlan landing a crucial blow and an archer shattering the entity's core to bring the fight to a close. After tending to Cassandra, the group reflects on the eerie familiarity of the location they have just survived, hinting at a cyclical threat. However, the adrenaline fades quickly as Trinket the dog dashes down the stairs in pursuit of something unseen, leaving the party to wonder what lies waiting at the bottom of the hall.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Race to the Ziggurat
episodes.description: Vox Machina breaches the Briarwoods' stronghold in Whitestone to rescue Cassandra and clear Percy's name after a chaotic revolt against the tyrants. The party successfully defeats spectral guardians and secures vital evidence before descending a mysterious tunnel toward the ominous Ziggurat project. As they prepare to move forward, Cassandra suddenly becomes distant and nervous, leaving the group to wonder if her sudden silence hides a secret that could jeopardize their mission.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Denouement: Part 1
episodes.description: The adventurers return to Whitestone to dismantle the Briarwoods' undead regime and rescue Percy's sister, Cassandra, from the depths of the Ziggurat. After a fierce battle that destroys Silas Briarwood and disrupts a dark ritual, the group manages to escape the structure while carrying their wounded allies. However, as they flee the dark tunnels, a mysterious spinning black orb begins to consume the very magic they rely on, threatening to trap them in the darkness once more.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Denouement: Part 2
episodes.description: Vox Machina fights for Percy’s soul as the Whitestone rebellion comes to a head! All this plus berets, tree hugging and… ships?

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Winter's Crest in Whitestone
episodes.description: It's Time for the Winters Crest festival in Whitestone! Contests, prizes, and revelry abound as we wrap up our year with a nice bow.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: A Musician's Nostalgia
episodes.description: Vox Machina return to Emon to prove their innocence. Now on the hunt for the treacherous Riskel Daxio, they must once again face the Clasp, along with some shady characters from Scanlan’s past.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Echoes of the Past
episodes.description: Vox Machina take some well earned downtime! Scanlan continues his dance with the mysterious gnome girl, and the group agrees to venture back to a mysterious cavern they had abandoned years before...

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Omens
episodes.description: Vox Machina is in disarray as a mysterious skull is found and Vax questions the priorities of the group. Meanwhile, the city of Emon experiences a substantial political shift.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Desperate Measures
episodes.description: Desperate to help survivors of the attack, Vox Machina attempt to fend off the assailing beasts, but our heroes are rendered helpless in the face of temptation, infighting and despair.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: In Ruins
episodes.description: Vox Machina searches through the rubble of Emon, hoping to find their allies among the survivors. With special guest Jason Charles Miller!

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Dangerous Dealings
episodes.description: In the wake of the devastation of Emon, Vox Machina begin making their long term plans to take back the city. But first, they must decide whether or not to make a devil's bargain with the Clasp: a dangerous underground criminal organization.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Return to Vasselheim
episodes.description: Now in the relative safety of Vasselheim, Vox Machina begin planning their first move against the Choma Conclave. Fortunately, some old friends turn up to offer their aid.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: The Sunken Tomb
episodes.description: Happy one year anniversary! On this most auspicious of days, Vox Machina find themselves deep within a lost shrine to the Raven Queen in search of an artifact that may help them defeat the Chroma conclave. But more danger lurks within the shrine than they could possibly be prepared for! With special guests Will Friedle and Mary Elizabeth Mcglynn.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Those Who Walk Away...
episodes.description: An exhausted Vox Machina spend some time hashing out their pent up frustrations and examining their spoils of victory. They then journey to the Fire Ashari, hoping to find survivors of the red dragons escape from the fire plane.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Cindergrove Revisited
episodes.description: Vox Machina joins forces with an eccentric candlemaker to help seal the rift between their world and the fire plane.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: The Family Business
episodes.description: Vox Machina return to the city where much of their history began: Westruun. But all is not well! Not only have the Chroma Conclave decimated the city, but another strangely familiar threat has taken hold of the city as well...

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Into the Frostweald
episodes.description: Vox Machina continue their quest to collect the vestiges. Along the way they are rejoined by Pike, and discover some other old friends in dire straits.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: A Name Is Earned
episodes.description: Vox Machina ventures deep beneath the Stormcrest Mountains to confront the mysterious Sphinx, and hopefully learn more about the Vestiges of Divergence.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Best Laid Plans...
episodes.description: Grog has a sword problem and the group stages an intervention, after which they begin to plan their attack on the Goliaths currently pillaging Westrunn. Everything is going to go great.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Test of Pride
episodes.description: Scanlan tries to plan a safe escape for his daughter Kaylie, while Grog makes his way to the center of Westrunn for his final confrontation with his uncle Kevdak.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: The Kill Box
episodes.description: Vox Machina infiltrates a town seized by Kewdak's barbaric tribe to retrieve a Vestige of Divergence needed to defeat the Chroma Conclave. After saving some citizens, Grog challenges Kewdak to a duel in a spiked pit, but the fight quickly escalates as the party engages the enemy archers from the rooftops. The session concludes with intense combat where the party uses tactical positioning and magic to mitigate damage while preparing to face the tribe's leader directly.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: At Dawn, We Plan!
episodes.description: After surviving the brutal battle against Kewdak, Vox Machina escorts the rescued child Theodore back to his home in the temple district of Westeren. They reunite with his mother, Alia, who is relieved to find him safe and unharmed, though she remains concerned about her missing grandfather. The party then uses magic to repair a broken shrine to Melora within Alia’s humble home, restoring the spiritual connection of the neighborhood.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: In the Belly of the Beast
episodes.description: Following their victory over the storm herd in Westruin, the adventurers spend the day preparing a massive trap to capture the ancient Black Dragon Umbra-Sil. Percy works with local blacksmiths to construct a giant net, while Scanlan consults Vax on dragon anatomy and considers a dangerous plan to teleport inside the beast's stomach to sabotage its acid glands. As they swap armor and finalize their ambush strategy, the party balances their urgent need to defeat the dragon with personal concerns and comedic moments before the battle begins.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Umbrasyl
episodes.description: After successfully trapping the ancient black dragon Umbrasil, Vox Machina faces a chaotic escape as the beast breaks its chains and flees toward its mountain domain. While Grog is dragged behind the fleeing dragon, Vax and Scanlan find themselves trapped inside its stomach, battling acidic conditions and muscular contractions to survive. Using a polymorphed snake form and precise surgical strikes, the duo attempts to widen an exit wound, leaving the party separated and the dragon soaring away with a piece of their equipment.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Hope
episodes.description: After Grog dealt the death blow to the formidable Black Dragon Umbra Sill atop the Gatt Shadow mountain, Vox Machina begins the arduous task of looting the beast's corpse for scales and teeth. The party sifts through the dragon's hoard, uncovering a staggering 78,000 gold pieces and precious gems, sparking a heated debate over how much wealth to take versus leaving for the displaced citizens of Westrin. Ultimately, they agree to take a portion of the funds to aid the homeless survivors while securing the remainder in a hidden stone wall, before discovering a mysterious magical ceramic jug amidst the pile.

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Duskmeadow
episodes.description: After securing Westrin and building a subterranean refuge, Vox Machina travels through a tree portal to the snowy streets of Vassalheim. At the Slayer's Take guild hall, the party sells their dragon scales to Vanessa for a significant payout while learning about the city's reinforced defenses against dragon incursions. With their loot secured and the Raven Queen's temple located, the heroes settle in to rest before plotting their next journey across the continent.

people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: A Cycle of Vengeance
episodes.description: The Rakshasa comes to Whitestone looking for vengeance as our heroes prepare for their journey into the Feywild.

people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: The Feywild
episodes.description: Vox Machina begin their adventure into the mysterious feywild! They quickly run into an old friend, and make a new one...

episodes.title: Denizens of the Moonbrush

people.name: Taliesin Jaffe
people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Uninviting Waters
episodes.description: With the Moonbrush behind them, Vox Machina presses on towards the rushing rivers of the Gilded Run that barricade the Shademirk Bog. Battling the enchanted currents, they stumble into a lurking foe who's hunger knows no bounds! (LIVE)

people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.description: Vox Machina go on a secret mission to the decimated city of Draconia, in the hopes of learning more about the Chroma Conclave. Also, there were some technical difficulties, so apologies for some of the roughness.

episodes.description: Vox Machina make their way to the distant continent of Marquet, traveling into the exotic city of Ank'Harel to seek allies and another vestige of power to aid in their war against the Chroma Conclave...and get slightly distracted.

people.role: Percival 'Percy' Fredrickstein Von Musel Klossowski de Rolo III

episodes.title: Vox Machina Go to Hell
episodes.description: Vox Machina descend into the nine hells, take a walking tour of the city of Dis, and sample the local cuisine.

episodes.title: Deals in the Dark
episodes.description: Vox Machina search the city of Dis for any alternative to making a deal with a devil.

episodes.title: Bats Out of Hell
episodes.description: With the dangers of the city of Dis looming, Vox Machina must surmount their dangerous agreement and find their quarry.

episodes.title: Jugs and Rods
episodes.description: Vox Machina raise a toast to a bit of well earned quiet. All that's left is for Vex to become mistress of the Grey Hunt...

episodes.title: One Year Later...
episodes.description: It’s been one year since we last saw Vox Machina, but the gang is getting back together for a group vacation to the Bay of Gifts!

episodes.title: Family Matters
episodes.description: There is a deadly curse upon the Trickfoot name, and it is unlike anything Vox Machina has ever faced…

episodes.title: Taryon, My Wayward Son
episodes.description: Tary's past catches up with him, as Vox Machina find themselves racing towards the city of Deastok.

episodes.title: The Mines of the Many
episodes.description: To save the Darrington family, Vox Machina descend deep into an abandoned mine.

episodes.title: Masquerade
episodes.description: Tary returns to deal with the distinction of his family, and echoes of the past follow Vox Machina to Whitestone.

episodes.title: Unfinished Business
episodes.description: Vox Machina make their way to the mysterious second Ziggurat outside Ank'Harel!

episodes.title: Thar Amphala
episodes.description: Vox Machina journey through the Ziggurat into the Shadowfell, hot on the trail of Delilah Briarwood.

episodes.title: Race to the Tower
episodes.description: All hell breaks loose as Vox Machina race to stop the return of Vecna!

episodes.title: The Fate-Touched
episodes.description: Vox Machina regroup after their devastating defeat at the hands of Vecna, all while Vax’s soul is tested by the Matron of Ravens.

episodes.title: Elysium
episodes.description: We journey to Elysium, where Vox Machina must prove their worth in the eyes of the gods!

episodes.title: The Fear of Isolation
episodes.description: Vox Machina travel to the pools of Wittebak where they meet a lonely stranger residing in a strange old house...

episodes.title: The Endless Atheneum
episodes.description: Vox Machina race against time to earn the blessing of the Goddess of Knowledge while Vecna continues to gain power.

episodes.title: Scaldseat
episodes.description: Vox Machina decend into the heart of an undersea volcano to find the forge of the gods.

episodes.title: The Core Anvil
episodes.description: Upon finding the Core Anvil and the forge guardian that protects it, Vox Machina attempt to create the divine trammels that will aid in their fight against Vecna.

episodes.title: The Ominous March
episodes.description: Vox Machina returns to Vasselheim to prepare for the coming of Vecna! (Live)

episodes.title: The Climb Within
episodes.description: Vox Machina find treasures, horrors, and mysteries as they make their way through the body of an undead primordial.

episodes.title: Shadows of Thomara
episodes.description: Vox Machina make their way through the cursed caverns of the undead dwarven city of Thomara, hoping their presence won't be discovered...

episodes.title: Dark Dealings
episodes.description: Vox Machina search for a powerful artifact that could help swing the tide in their favor. Nothing could possibly go wrong...

episodes.title: The Final Ascent
episodes.description: Vox Machina, having made their final preparations, make their way to the top of the tower of Entropis.

episodes.title: Vecna, the Ascended
episodes.description: Vox Machina battles Vecna.

episodes.title: The Chapter Closes
episodes.description: Victory is celebrated, and all debts are paid…
